::: {#rem-prediction-error-expected}
#### Expected squared prediction error

The [expected value](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) of the [squared prediction error](#def-squared-prediction-error) $\sqprederr$
for a [new observation](model-validation.qmd#def-new-observation)
at a given [covariate](model-validation.qmd#def-covariate) value
is the [expected squared prediction error](model-validation.qmd#def-epe).
:::
